title: Wintersday 2008

[[Wintersday 2008]] is different from the other Wintersday events. It will feature new things, and for the first time in Guild Wars, it will also be celebrated in the [[Eye of the North]]! == Wintersday 2008 Opens Up the Eye of the North == [[Image:Thackeray.jpg|right|89px]] {| style="background: transparent;" | style="background: {{W-color|tint}}; border:1px solid {{W-color|border}}; padding: .5em 1em; -moz-border-radius: 1em;"| ''On behalf of the Ebon Vanguard, I am pleased to extend our invitation to this year's Wintersday celebration. Most of the Vanguard is off-duty to take part in the festivities, so please join us in the Eye of the North as we relax and make merry. It has fallen to me to make sure everyone has a proper good time, a duty that I gladly accept. I just hope no one minds if I have a little fun for myself along the way. --Lt. Thackeray'' |} {{clear}} == Schedule == {| {{STDT}} ! Finales in Kamadan have a 15 minute delay like they did during [[Wintersday 2006]] and [[Wintersday 2007|2007]]. The Wintersday Finale is similar to [[Nine Rings]] at the [[Shing Jea Boardwalk]] but with [[Candy Cane Shard|Candy Cane Shards]] instead of [[Festival Ticket | Festival Tickets]]. Playing this game counts towards your [[Lucky and Unlucky]] title tracks. The center circle gives the most lucky points, whilst the outer circles contribute most to your unlucky title. At the end of the finale, presents will be put in your inventory, taking up approximately 15 minutes, so be sure to stay logged on that character if you want to receive the presents. === Festival hats === On the final days, the rival gods [[Grenth]] and [[Dwayna]] called upon the people of the town for their support. The God with the most followers, rewarded the people of the town with a [[festival hat]]. Followers of Grenth stood upon the ''red'' rings, and the followers of Dwayna upon the ''green'' or ''blue'' rings. Unlike in previous events, characters will not receive duplicates of hats they already have. *The victory of Dwayna will give every player a [[Rudi Mask]]. *The victory of Grenth will give every player a [[Grentch Cap]]. {| style="margin:0.25em; border:1px solid silver; text-align:center;" cellpadding="5" cellspacing="0" rules="all" |- style="background-color:#FDA;" ! [[Rudi Mask]] || [[Grentch Cap]] |- | [[Image:Rudi Mask.png]] || [[Image:Grentch Cap.png]] |} {{clear}} ==Decorated Towns== [[Image:Wintersday 2008 Lions Arch.jpg|thumb|200px|Wintersday in Lion's Arch]] [[Image:Wintersday 2008 Droknars Forge.jpg|thumb|200px|Wintersday in Droknar's Forge]] [[Image:Wintersday 2008 Ascalon City.jpg|thumb|200px|Wintersday in Ascalon City]] [[Image:Wintersday 2008 Kamadan.jpg|thumb|200px|Wintersday in Kamadan]] [[Image:Wintersday 2008 eotn2.jpg|thumb|200px|Wintersday in Eye of the North]] *[[Lion's Arch]] *[[Droknar's Forge]] *[[Ascalon City]] *[[Kamadan]] *[[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]] == New features == * Speak to [[Keiran Thackeray|Lieutenant Thackeray]] in the Eye of the North to find out how you can help the Ebon Vanguard enjoy Wintersday through a new chain of quests! * Brand new 8v8 ATS-style [[Snowball Tournament]]s! * You can tame the new [[Jingle Bear]] in [[Gwen's garden]] if you complete all four of the Eye of the North Wintersday quests. == Returning features == * Two well-known Wintersday quests are back to let you side with Grenth and his grentches or Dwayna and her snowmen before their final showdown. Unsure which deity to support? Try both quests to pick your favorite! * Quest chains from past years that involve certain beloved (and rare) holiday-themed animals. * Two repeatable quests set in the (previously) [[Secret Lair of the Snowmen]]. It's your choice: help save the snowmen, and all of Wintersday, or lead a group of grentches on a final "bah, humbug" of the season. * Venture into the [[Underworld]] for a series of repeatable snowball fights against the forces of Grenth or the forces of Dwayna. Take control of piles of presents to win victory for your side in this frosty fray. * More snowball mayhem in the form of PvP [[Dwayna Vs Grenth|snowball fight]]s! Random forces unite within an arena to fight for either Grenth or Dwayna. The first team to gather five presents for its patron deity wins the day. * Embrace the old adage "it is better to give than to receive" at the city event game in Lion's Arch, Droknar's Forge, Kamadan, and Ascalon City. Deliver [[Present (bundle)|presents]] to the children before the grentches destroy Wintersday. The outcome of Wintersday could hang in the balance. Besides, you never know what somebody might trade for them, (but you might want to hold onto your shards until the finale, and use them for good…or mischievous…intent). |- | [[Image:Miniature Polar Bear.png]] || [[Miniature Polar Bear]]: Help the Snowmen or Grentches in their two quests and maybe you'll get a little treat at the end! |- |- | [[Image:Rudi Mask.png]] || [[Rudi Mask]]: Support Dwayna and win this hat in the Wintersday Finale! |- |- | [[Image:Grentch Cap.png]] || [[Grentch Cap]]: Support Grenth and win this hat in the Wintersday Finale! |- |} == Notes == * During the finale, like previous years, many players are trying to make [[Grenth]] win in odd districts (1, 3, 5 etc.), and [[Dwayna]] win in even districts (2, 4, 6 etc.) This is a practised method players have created to ensure that everyone gets the festival hat they want. * Unlike previous years, when [[Wintersday Gift]]s were dropped on the ground, this year they are automatically added to your inventory. This prevents the lag everyone suffered during last year's festivities and the chance of presents dropping to unreachable places. * Attending in [[Lion's Arch]] during the finale first, and then zoning to [[Kamadan]] would get you both hats if your district timings are correct. A good rule of thumb is hang out after the festival in LA for about 4 minutes, then move to the opposite district in Kamadan in order to max out on presents in addition to collecting both hats. * Your district will miss the event if it was created ''after the start of the event for that town'' so make sure you arrive before the due time. *When the event was over and the NPCs were gone, the [[Winter Dwarf]] was still there, without cage. == See also == *[[Wintersday Art Contest (2008)]] *[http://www.guildwars.com/events/ingame/wintersday2008/ GuildWars.com event page] {{Special events nav}} [[Category:Wintersday 2008]]
